18.topic: Proof - the condition is equivalent to Disc(quadratic in x) = 0
18.verified_text: Proof: | ax² + 2(by + g)x + (by² + 2fy + c) = 0 | Quad. in x (cyan label) | x = [-2(by + g) ± √((2(by + g))² - 4a(by² + 2fy + c))] / 2a | annotations: Quad. in y (magenta), Perfect square (magenta), 'Iss Quad ka D = 0' (magenta + Hindi), cond^n -> abc + 2fgh - af² - bg² - ch² = 0 (orange, bottom-right)
